---
name: Feature Request
description: Propose a new capability, media workflow, or enhancement for MUXARO
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "triage"]
---

## Problem Statement
Describe the problem, workflow gap, or user need this feature addresses.

## Proposed Solution
Describe the desired behavior, API contract, or UI/UX flow.

## Affected Components
- [ ] Web App (`apps/web`)
- [ ] REST & SSE API (`apps/api`)
- [ ] FFmpeg Media Worker (`apps/media-worker`)
- [ ] Entitlements & Quota Engine (`packages/entitlements`)
- [ ] Source Adapters (`packages/source-adapters`)
- [ ] Security Module (`security`)
- [ ] Documentation / Infrastructure

## Security, Privacy & Rights Considerations
Does this feature introduce new network egress, external URL handling, authentication changes, file uploads, or media source adapters? If so, note any SSRF, validation, or rights-compliance constraints.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative approaches or workarounds you evaluated.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Clear, testable expected behavior
- [ ] Automated test coverage plan
- [ ] Documentation updates identified
